audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown is attached to any of his spikes — the packet's only defect line is 'NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere'.
audit.why: Every instruction on the page is 'punish the post-E window' or 'commit when it is down' with no number, so the player cannot count anything. Purgatory is 120s at rank 1, Ashen Pursuit is a flat 10s at every rank, Soul Nails is 10s falling to 6s, Soul Ignition is 18s falling to 14s.

audit.whatIsWrong: full.phases[0].why and breakdown.wave both call him 'a 125-range' champion, and report[8] says his damage is AP so 'Early HP and MR blunt the nail chip'.
audit.why: Nothing in the kit is 125 range: Soul Nails is 950, Ashen Pursuit 425, Soul Ignition 250, Purgatory 1000. And Soul Ignition carries true damage, which is the brief's resistances-invalidated flag — telling the player to buy MR against it is the wrong answer. His passive on-hit does scale with the target's MISSING health, which is the real reason not to linger low.
audit.corrected: Ranges corrected to the kit's; MR advice replaced with health plus anti-heal; the missing-health scaling on his passive stated as the reason low-HP fights compound.

audit.whatIsWrong: report[8] states 'Anti-heal is optional — his sustain is self-refund, not lifesteal.'
audit.why: That is a distinction Grievous Wounds does not make: Soul Ignition ends by healing him back a portion of the damage he took, and anti-heal reduces healing regardless of source. The brief flags needs-antiheal for exactly this ability. The page currently talks a Sion player OUT of the item that decides the extended trade.
audit.corrected: Anti-heal restated as core, tied to the W refund; mid now says Grievous Wounds beats stacking armour here.
